item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Beach Background for My Portrait

turns.text: Swap the park behind me for a sunny beach with sand and blue sea. Keep my face, hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing the same. Still square, please.

item.tests: Tests beach background replacement while preserving portrait identity, framing and fine hair edges.

answer_sheet.Beach setting: A photorealistic sunny beach with visible sand and blue sea; the location is your call.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: My face, curly hair, sweater, pose and head-and-shoulders framing.
answer_sheet.Size and added text: One square image at the standard free size. No added text.

must_haves: The woman remains recognizably the same person, with the same expression and pose.
Her curly hair and sweater are preserved with clean, natural-looking edges.
Sand and blue sea replace the park background.
The portrait remains head-and-shoulders rather than inventing a full body.
The square image looks like a coherent photograph, not a visibly pasted cutout.

turns.text: In this pic, swap the park behind me for a sunny beach with sand and blue sea. Keep my face, hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing the same. Still square, please. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **one square image at up to 640 × 640 using FLUX 2 Klein**, which is available on the free plan. Its listed price **starts at 5 credits per image**; I can’t verify an exact quote or your remaining balance with the tools available here.

I’d request only the background change: sunny sand and blue sea, keeping your face, hair, sweater, and head-and-shoulders framing unchanged. Generative editing can introduce small differences, so exact preservation isn’t guaranteed.

- **Cheaper/smaller:** 640px and one image are the lowest listed settings for this edit.
- **Shorter:** Not applicable to a still image.
- No upscale or extra variations are needed.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Would you like to proceed with the lowest-cost option, or hold off because the exact charge isn’t verified?

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has **insufficient credits**. No image was generated.

We already chose the lowest-cost listed option: one square 640px image with FLUX 2 Klein, starting at 5 credits. There isn’t a cheaper listed setting for this edit, so I haven’t retried or switched tools.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit only the background of this portrait: replace the entire park, trees, grass and path behind the woman with a realistic sunny beach, warm pale sand and a clear blue sea, with a natural distant horizon and sunny blue sky. Preserve the woman exactly as in the original: same facial identity, facial features, expression, skin texture, dark curly hair and individual curls, gray knit sweater, pose, subject size and position. Preserve the identical head-and-shoulders framing, original square composition and camera viewpoint. Do not retouch, beautify, change clothing, crop or reframe the woman. Clean natural edges around the hair and sweater. Photorealistic background, believable daylight.
